metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds the share, the glass promised to Burbage, and a shut chronicle.

yesterday: The king is come down. The lords look at his hands. He looks at the ground. Under that, you wrote send for a glass.
John said four shillings, and that it would be broken every time.
Gib is on the shut chronicle. Susanna is still eleven. The thimble is still on the road.
There is ink on your finger from tonight.
